externalDependencies.detail: No verified external payment rail is available in this environment. Runs settle through 'local-ledger', a team-controlled, explicitly labeled merchant adapter. Reports mark settlement local_only and never present unconfirmed payment as settled. Missing proof: live merchant order id, rail name, signed receipt, amount and network for a real paid reservation.

Separate enrolled org identities are enforced and reported, but both orgs are operated by the same local owner in this build. A production claim needs a genuinely independent operator plus a verified commercial rail.

sandbox-exec seatbelt profile is implemented (deny network*, read-only inputs, bounded output) but sandbox_apply is denied inside this build sandbox, so demo runs record containment 'unsandboxed'. Re-run scripts/demo.mjs on an unrestricted macOS host to capture 'sandbox-exec:no-network'.
